articles.title: Backtrade Launches on Hyperliquid With a Token Minted From Every Losing Trade
articles.description: The new perpetuals exchange converts trader losses into BACK, a token that pays holders a share of exchange fees in USDC. NEW YORK, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Backtrade, a perpetual futures exchange built on Hyperliquid’s HyperEVM, opened to all traders today. When a trader on Backtrade closes a position at a loss or gets liquidated, the exchange mints BACK to that trader. BACK holders split half of the exchange’s fees, paid in USDC. The launch comes during a rough stretch for leveraged traders. CoinGlass recorded $1.96 billion in crypto liquidations in the 24 hours to November 15, the day bitcoin fell to about $62,000. Most of those traders never had the odds on their side. Studies cited by Crypto Briefing put the share of day traders who lose money over time at 70% to 97%. A Bank for International Settlements paper estimated that 73% to 81% of retail investors lost money on their first bitcoin purchases. Backtrade is live. Start trading at app.backtrade.xyz: connect a wallet and deposit from 10 USDC. "Every exchange makes money when its traders lose. We built Backtrade so that the traders who fill the pool are the people it pays,” said Lucas, founder of Backtrade. How a Loss Turns into BACK Backtrade has no order book. You open positions against a USDC pool the team calls the house. The house started at zero, and only trader losses fill it; outside investors cannot deposit. When you lose, the house keeps the loss and mints you 100 BACK for each dollar it keeps. A liquidation mints 100 BACK per dollar of margin. The BACK starts earning at the next distribution. Holders share 50% of every win, loss and liquidation fee. Once the house has paid winning traders, it also sends holders anything above $500,000. Seven days after minting, your tokens burn, and the USDC they earned stays claimable. A Token with No Insiders BACK supply started at zero. The team and investors received no allocation, and Backtrade ran no airdrop. You cannot buy, sell or transfer BACK. Backtrade’s documentation states that the project promises no value for the token. An Edge for Early Traders The seven-day burn countdown starts only after the house first reaches $500,000. Traders who lose before that point keep earning until the pool fills, and for seven days after it does. Risks No external firm has audited Backtrade’s contracts yet. If the house runs short, winning traders wait for payment in a first-in, first-out queue. At 1000x on BTC, a move of about 0.05% against you wipes out the margin. Open Backtrade and follow @backtrade_xyz on X. About Backtrade Backtrade is a perpetual futures exchange running in smart contracts on Hyperliquid’s HyperEVM. Traders go long or short on BTC and ETH with up to 1000x leverage, fills at the Hyperliquid mid and no funding payments. Every losing trade mints BACK, a token that earns a share of exchange fees in USDC. Website: backtrade.xyz · Docs: docs.backtrade.xyz · X: @backtrade_xyz CoinGlass, Crypto Briefing, Bank for International Settlements. This article is for information only and is not financial advice. Leveraged trading carries a high risk of loss. articles.title: Valeura Share Buyback Programme
articles.description: SINGAPORE, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Valeura Energy Inc. (TSX:VLE, OTCQX:VLERF) ("Valeura” or the "Company”) has received Toronto Stock Exchange ("TSX”) approval of the Company’s notice of intention to make a new Normal Course Issuer Bid ("NCIB”). The NCIB will commence on 20 November 2026 and end on 19 November 2027, or such earlier date as Valeura may determine or upon completion of purchases pursuant to the NCIB. Under the NCIB, Valeura may purchase up to 6,956,023 of its common shares ("Shares”), representing approximately 10% of the public float of Shares as at 06 November 2026. As at 06 November 2026 there were 106,283,899 Shares outstanding. Valeura’s management and board feel it is appropriate to offset natural dilution and see the NCIB as a suitable tool to pursue this goal, while also potentially reducing the total Shares outstanding. This reflects the Company’s belief that the market price of the Shares may not reflect Valeura’s intrinsic value and future prospects. The Company believes the purchase of Shares may represent an appropriate use of Valeura’s financial resources to enhance shareholder value. Purchases made pursuant to the NCIB will be made in the open market through the facilities of the TSX and/or through alternative Canadian trading systems and all Shares purchased pursuant to the NCIB will be cancelled. The number of Shares that can be purchased is subject to a daily maximum, subject to certain exceptions, of 106,195 Shares, which is equal to 25% of the average daily trading volume of 424,780 for the Shares on the TSX for the period 01 May 2026 to 31 October 2026. Valeura may also employ an automatic share purchase plan with a designated broker, which will allow for purchases of Shares at pre-determined levels at times when Valeura would not otherwise be active in the market due to applicable regulatory restrictions or internal trading black-out periods. This new NCIB follows the Company’s previous normal course issuer bid (the "Expiring NCIB”) which commenced on 20 November 2025 and will end on 19 November 2026. Under the Expiring NCIB, the Company received TSX approval to purchase up to 6,298,884 Shares. Valeura did not purchase any shares under the Expiring NCIB but purchased 130,000 options and 685,460 performance and restricted share units under the same time period, that would have resulted in the issuance of new shares when exercised. articles.title: Valeura Share Buyback Programme
articles.description: SINGAPORE, Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Valeura Energy Inc. (TSX:VLE, OTCQX:VLERF) (“Valeura” or the “Company”) has received Toronto Stock Exchange (“TSX”) approval of the Company’s notice of intention to make a new Normal Course Issuer Bid (“NCIB”). The NCIB will commence on 20 November 2026 and end on 19 November 2027, or such earlier date as Valeura may determine or upon completion of purchases pursuant to the NCIB. Under the NCIB, Valeura may purchase up to 6,956,023 of its common shares (“Shares”), representing approximately 10% of the public float of Shares as at 06 November 2026. As at 06 November 2026 there were 106,283,899 Shares outstanding.
